title: Mordheim KB registry — registry/runtime-scope.yaml
description: Scope policy of the runtime: the declared scope, the mechanics and profiles excluded from it with a reason each, the supported combat traits, and what a special rule means when it carries no executable binding.

profile_exclusions.description: Profiles excluded from the runtime; empty today.

mechanic_exclusions.description: Mechanics of the catalogue that stay out of the runtime, each with the reason why.

reason.description: Why the mechanic is outside the scope, phrased as the audit taxonomy does (`shooting`, `campaign`, `movement` …).

special_rule_policy.description: What happens to a special rule without an executable binding.

supported_combat_traits.description: Combat traits that participate in one-against-one combat; they are keys of `profiles.yaml` `combat_traits` and of `mordheim_construction.contracts.TRAIT_TYPES`.
